unit.evidence: In-process cases over the validator, the policy derivation, the attestation, the memory, the guardrail registry, the preflight fingerprint, the derived counts, the seal chronology and the internal assurance artifacts.

integration.evidence: Cases that build isolated Git repositories or run the tooling as a subprocess: the delta inventory, detached validation, finalization recording, the Green Keeper harness, the integrity anchors over a real clone, the historical compatibility of every sealed tag, and the end-to-end delivery lifecycle through seal_checkpoint.py.

e2e.evidence: No functional runtime exists in SETUP-00, so runtime end-to-end testing is not applicable. The delivery lifecycle case exercises the control plane end to end and is counted as integration.
